create_hedge_algorithm: create a Hedge algorithm instance for MFGs with custom eta, policies, and game parameters
run_hedge_step: run a single Hedge algorithm step that updates weights based on sampled policy rewards
run_hedge_step_for: run Hedge algorithm step_for T iterations with optional welfare bonus and decay
compute_hedge_regret: compute the average external or internal regret of the Hedge algorithm over all steps
get_hedge_nu_distribution: get the current population distribution (nu) from the Hedge algorithm's policy weights
